overall: Monday, June 22 is expected to be mostly sunny with warm and humid conditions, with a chance of showers and thunderstorms developing after 11am ahead of a more significant storm system arriving Monday night (70% PoP). Southwest winds of 5-10 mph gusting to 25 mph will aid afternoon heating before convection develops. Daytime conditions should allow temperatures to climb close to 89°F before afternoon cloud cover and storm activity limit further warming.
